bds.h: 2 men arrested after break-in at country residence of Prince William, Princess of Wales
bds.lede: British police said Tuesday that two men have been arrested over a suspected burglary at the Royal Family's Sandringham Estate. It follows reports that the home of Prince William and Princess Catherine on the vast royal estate was broken into on Monday.
rows: Police said that “the property was unoccupied at the time of the incident.”

British police arrest two men in connection with a suspected burglary at Sandringham, the estate of Prince William and Princess Kate. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports on the latest developments in the investigation and what authorities are saying about the incident.
Intruders have broken into the country residence of Prince William and Princess Catherine, British media reported Tuesday.
The arrests were made at a property on ⁠⁠⁠⁠the royal family's Sandringham estate in Norfolk, eastern England.

British police said Tuesday that two men have been arrested over a suspected burglary at the Royal Family's Sandringham Estate. It follows reports that the home of Prince William and Princess Catherine on the vast royal estate was broken into on Monday.
British police said that officers were called Monday evening to reported “suspicious activity” at an address on the rural estate of Sandringham in eastern England.
